items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: "Give me some tobacco please. Dunhill, for Mr. Appleyard."

ctx.x: Right. I’ll take that in my salary.
Anyway, he took me downstairs when we were leaving, and I smoked a pipe in those days, and he stopped and said, “Just a minute.” He said, “Give me some tobacco please. Dunhill, for Mr. Appleyard.”
Well he operated on his own terms, didn’t he, to be generous or to be the typical Benny.
